items.headline: Markey, Neal, and Lynch projected winners in Massachusetts Democratic primaries
items.detail: NBC News’ Steve Kornacki breaks down numbers in the Democratic primary races in Massachusetts including U.S. Senate and House Districts 8 and 1.

items.headline: Democratic Rep. Stephen Lynch defeats a younger challenger in Massachusetts primary
items.detail: Lynch won against Patrick Roath, NBC News projects, who is more than three decades younger and came at him from the left.

items.headline: Alaska finalizes Senate race for November: 3 Republicans — 2 Dan Sullivans — and 1 Democrat
items.detail: Former Rep. Mary Peltola will be the only Democrat on the ballot after Democrat David Leslie, who finished fourth in the primary, withdrew.

items.headline: Key Texas county votes to cut polling sites ahead of the midterms
items.detail: Officials in Tarrant County, the third most-populous in Texas, approved a plan to reduce the number of polling locations by 92 compared to the 2022 elections.

items.headline: No plans for ICE to be at polls for midterms, DHS says
items.detail: A senior DHS official said ICE will do its regular duties on the day of midterm elections, though Secretary Markwayne Mullin said agents would enter a polling place to serve a warrant.

items.detail: Sen. Ed Markey (D-Mass.) bucked this cycle's recent trend of old guard Democrats losing primaries to younger challengers, easily routing his rival in Tuesday's primary for Senate in Massachusetts.

items.detail: BlackRock Investment Institute’s Ben Powell says the Middle East conflict is likely to accelerate the GCC’s push toward economic resilience, diversification and greater self-reliance.

items.headline: Iran attacks US bases in Middle East after reports US strike killed five at wedding party
items.detail: The Iranian Red Crescent says a child was among those killed when shrapnel from a US strike hit a home. The US military says it is aware of the reports and it never targets civilians.

items.headline: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
items.detail: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

items.headline: BBC travels inside occupied Lebanon as officials say Israel expanding positions
items.detail: A BBC team joined a humanitarian mission of the UN peacekeeping force, which says Israeli troops are fortifying positions and continuing demolitions.

items.headline: South Korea jails care home head for sexually assaulting disabled residents
items.detail: The man, surnamed Kim, was handed a 15-year prison term for abusing three residents at the facility near Seoul.

items.detail: A US Postal Service whistleblower has warned that a new ballot-processing system ordered by President Donald Trump and due to launch Tuesday could prevent millions of Americans from receiving mail ballots ahead of November's midterm…

items.detail: A judge in the US state of Utah has ruled that the man accused of shooting far-right activist Charlie Kirk will face trial for murder.

items.headline: Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion
items.detail: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong on Wednesday pleaded guilty to colluding with foreign powers in a trial that could see the 29-year-old spend the rest of his life behind bars.

items.headline: USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier docks in Thailand after nine months at sea
items.detail: More than 5,000 US sailors and Marines arrived in Thailand Wednesday after nine months at sea on the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier.

items.headline: Middle East live: Iran launches retaliatory strikes after fresh US bombing kills 11 people
items.detail: Iranian state media reported Wednesday that US strikes killed 11 people in two separate attacks, including four at a wedding in the country’s south.
